verdict.rationale: SumUp runs its own managed MCP server that lets AI assistants act on a user's account: managing it, creating checkouts and processing payments. That makes natural-language operation possible, but only through a third-party MCP client. The Agent Toolkit is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside SumUp itself, documented examples of natural-language commands and how they map to actions, coverage of which operations are exposed, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments using Cloud API.
Use the SumUp MCP server to connect MCP-compatible clients and AI assistants to SumUp APIs and documentation tools.
